title: Return interrupted/cancelled run outcomes from the job mark and add the retryable envelope bit
action: In run.rs: (1) add `RunOutcome::Interrupted` and `RunOutcome::Cancelled` (enum at run.rs:1782); `outcome_label` (run.rs:2722) returns `interrupted` / `cancelled`; `exit_code_for` gives them the same non-zero class as `died`. (2) In the poll tick closure (run.rs ~2100-2145) call `mailbox::read_mark(bee_dir, job_id)` once per tick beside status_with_activity; a mark `interrupted` ends the wait with Outcome Interrupted and the pane stays open (D1: never close it; should_close_pane returns false for it); a mark `cancelled` ends with Cancelled (pane already closed by the cancel verb, closed_pane true); `cancel_pending` keeps waiting. Thread the mark through PollTick/PollDecision in the smallest way that keeps run_poll_loop testable (one new PollTick field, one PollDecision variant). (3) In execute_continue (run.rs:2424) after the paused_limit_at check: mark `cancelled` or `cancel_pending` refuses with a new `ContinueRefusal::Cancelled { job_id, mark }` whose text ends with a FIX line naming `bee herding cancel <job-id>` for a pending one; mark `interrupted` is accepted and `mailbox::clear_mark` runs before the resume. (4) In result_envelope (run.rs ~2840) add key `retryable` on every envelope except outcome `done` and `dry_run`: `true` only for `spawn_failed`, `false` for every other label including `blocked`, `interrupted`, `cancelled` (D3 1ef811f7; no new key on done/dry_run per the no-new-key law afec9446). Update the envelope-key doc comment that lists keys. Tests beside the existing run.rs tests: run_poll_loop returns Interrupted on an interrupted tick with pane open; Cancelled on a cancelled tick; execute_continue refuses cancelled and cancel_pending with the FIX line, accepts interrupted and clears the mark; envelope has retryable true on spawn_failed, false on died/blocked/interrupted/cancelled/timed_out_idle, absent on done and dry_run.
